method: CPU only. In-memory esbuild compiles exact current camera module, current V5World anteriorInterior, viewWeight, gate prefix and organ-alpha loop; source/public files are never written. Local atlas triangles are decoded using GLTFLoader. Projection is bounding-box candidate visibility only, with no rasterization, lighting, occlusion, text or perceptual validation.
anchorProvenance: Unchanged static anchors inherit previously CPU cross-checked metrics; personActivity restored to its constructor coordinate. Muscle and kidney anchors recomputed from current actual helper and GLBs, cardio anchors recomputed from current procedural geometry and aortic route.

plasmaBridge.projectionLimitations: Counts use projected triangle-vertex bounding boxes, including offscreen partial objects. They do not establish useful visibility or absence of transparent sorting artifacts. Existing RBC contexts are included for overlap assessment.

limitations: No browser, WebGL, GPU, renderer, source edits or public edits.
CPU gate continuity is not raster/perceptual continuity.
Current-final report does not re-audit dynamic clothing or cuff deformation.
Source stability check detects edits during this run; later source edits invalidate corresponding claims.
